label calls.cohort_rule: same eligible hidden entities and classes
label calls.limitation: No test prevalence used for fitting; unseen classes remain visible

values.cohort_rule: same eligible finite hidden values with declared units
values.limitation: No imputation of missing truth or central tendency fitted on test

ranking.cohort_rule: identical frozen candidate universe, seed exclusions and fixed depth
ranking.limitation: Unlabelled entities are not verified negatives; PU precision/AUPRC not identifiable

set retrieval.cohort_rule: identical frozen candidate universe and set size
set retrieval.limitation: Positive-only recall is limited to known positives

controls: protected-group label null on fixed placements
cluster recovery.cohort_rule: same hidden labelled entities, placements and noise mask
cluster recovery.limitation: Geometry/stability do not establish biological module accuracy

replication.cohort_rule: same discovery selection and independent validation population
replication.limitation: Split-half replication does not establish new-dataset replication
